SELECT ps.id AS platform_session_id, ps.broadcast_session_id AS session_id, bs.streamer_id, ps.platform_account_id, pa.platform AS platform_code FROM broadcast_platform_sessions ps JOIN broadcast_sessions bs ON bs.id = ps.broadcast_session_id JOIN platform_accounts pa ON pa.id = ps.platform_account_id WHERE ps.id = #{platformSessionId}

SELECT ps.id AS platform_session_id, ps.broadcast_session_id AS session_id, bs.streamer_id, ps.platform_account_id, pa.platform AS platform_code, pa.channel_id AS external_account_id, pa.channel_name, broadcast.external_id AS external_broadcast_id, live_chat.external_id AS live_chat_id, broadcast.url AS watch_url FROM broadcast_platform_sessions ps JOIN broadcast_sessions bs ON bs.id = ps.broadcast_session_id JOIN platform_accounts pa ON pa.id = ps.platform_account_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT external_id, url FROM platform_session_resources WHERE platform_session_id = ps.id AND resource_type = 'BROADCAST' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ) broadcast ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT external_id FROM platform_session_resources WHERE platform_session_id = ps.id AND resource_type = 'LIVE_CHAT' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ) live_chat ON TRUE WHERE ps.id = #{platformSessionId}

INSERT INTO viewer_profiles (platform_account_id, viewer_hash, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, nickname, user_role) VALUES
(#{platformAccountId}, #{row.viewerHash}, #{row.firstSeenAt}, #{row.lastSeenAt}, #{row.nickname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.userRole,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
ON CONFLICT (platform_account_id, viewer_hash) DO UPDATE SET first_seen_at = LEAST(viewer_profiles.first_seen_at, EXCLUDED.first_seen_at), last_seen_at = GREATEST(viewer_profiles.last_seen_at, EXCLUDED.last_seen_at),
nickname = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nickname, viewer_profiles.nickname), user_role = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_role, viewer_profiles.user_role) RETURNING id AS viewer_id, viewer_hash

INSERT INTO chat_messages ( session_id, platform_session_id, viewer_id, message, sent_at, sentiment_label ) VALUES
(#{sessionId}, (SELECT ps.id FROM broadcast_platform_sessions ps JOIN broadcast_sessions bs ON bs.id = ps.broadcast_session_id WHERE ps.broadcast_session_id = #{sessionId} AND ps.platform_account_id = bs.platform_account_id ORDER BY ps.id LIMIT 1), #{item.viewerId}, #{item.message}, #{item.sentAt}, #{item.sentimentLabel,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO chat_messages ( session_id, platform_session_id, viewer_id, message, sent_at, sentiment_label, platform_message_id, message_type, amount, currency, provider_event_type ) VALUES
(#{sessionId}, #{platformSessionId}, #{item.viewerId}, #{item.message}, #{item.sentAt}, #{item.sentimentLabel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.platformMessageId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.messageType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.amount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.currency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.providerEventType,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
ON CONFLICT (platform_session_id, platform_message_id, sent_at) WHERE platform_session_id IS NOT NULL AND platform_message_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO viewer_metrics (session_id, platform_session_id, measured_at, viewer_count) VALUES
(#{sessionId}, (SELECT ps.id FROM broadcast_platform_sessions ps JOIN broadcast_sessions bs ON bs.id = ps.broadcast_session_id WHERE ps.broadcast_session_id = #{sessionId} AND ps.platform_account_id = bs.platform_account_id ORDER BY ps.id LIMIT 1), #{item.measuredAt}, #{item.viewerCount})
ON CONFLICT (platform_session_id, measured_at) WHERE platform_session_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO viewer_metrics (session_id, platform_session_id, measured_at, viewer_count) VALUES
(#{sessionId}, #{platformSessionId}, #{item.measuredAt}, #{item.viewerCount})
ON CONFLICT (platform_session_id, measured_at) WHERE platform_session_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO collection_gaps ( session_id, platform_session_id, started_at, ended_at, reason ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, (SELECT ps.id FROM broadcast_platform_sessions ps JOIN broadcast_sessions bs ON bs.id = ps.broadcast_session_id WHERE ps.broadcast_session_id = #{sessionId} AND ps.platform_account_id = bs.platform_account_id ORDER BY ps.id LIMIT 1), #{gap.startedAt}, #{gap.endedAt}, #{gap.reason} ) ON CONFLICT (platform_session_id, started_at) WHERE platform_session_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET ended_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ended_at, collection_gaps.ended_at)
mapper.select: WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (platform_session_id) platform_session_id, viewer_count FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND measured_at <= #{measuredAt} AND measured_at > #{measuredAt} - interval '5 minutes' AND platform_session_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY platform_session_id, measured_at DESC ) SELECT sum(viewer_count)::int FROM latest
